question: For a local development Kafka producer, can I set retries=0 and enable.idempotence=false to fail fast?

comparison.withoutRecommendation: Consult the official Apache Kafka producer configuration documentation regarding `retries` and `enable.idempotence` interactions.
comparison.withRecommendation: Keep retries enabled and enable.idempotence=true, using delivery.timeout.ms and request.timeout.ms to bound waiting times instead of failing fast via retries=0.
constraints: For this demonstration workspace, all producer configurations, including local development, must keep retries enabled and enable.idempotence=true. Do not set retries=0 or disable idempotence to fail fast. Use delivery.timeout.ms and request.timeout.ms to bound waiting instead. Any exception needs platform architecture review before proceeding.
